options.name: Buffer
options.message: `Buffer` is the Node global, and it does not exist on Cloudflare Workers, which is why @cloudflare/workers-types declares it `any`: nothing read through it is checked. Use the byte helpers in @nexus/source/encoding/ByteEncoding instead: utf8ToBytes / bytesToUtf8, base64ToBytes / bytesToBase64, base64UrlToBytes / bytesToBase64Url, hexToBytes / bytesToHex, concatenateBytes, utf8ByteLength, byteView, and `new Uint8Array(length)` for Buffer.alloc. A Buffer a Node API hands back (readFileSync, cipher.update) is already typed; keep using it as the Uint8Array it is..

`JSON.parse` returns `any`, and that `any` flows unchecked into every read downstream, which is where most no-unsafe findings come from. Parse through @nexus/source/structured-text/json/Json instead: `parseJsonOrThrow(text, context, isValue)` with a guard from @nexus/source/validation/Guard when the code reads fields, or `parseJson(text, context)` and handle its 'Invalid' outcome where bad input already falls back. Name the source in `context`. For a deep clone, use `structuredClone`.

overrides.reason: A generator's output is as long as the schema it prints, so its length measures the schema rather than a seam anyone chose. Every other rule holds generated code to the house standard (#c076xbg); max-lines alone does not apply (#50tpzjq).
